data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 3.5m was experienced in 2018 (2017: GBP 18.1m surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 1.7m on direct business (2017: GBP 22.5m surplus) and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business (2017: GBP 4.4m deficit).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 111.035m. During 2018 the syndicate experienced a GBP 3.5m favourable run-off (release) in prior-year claims provisions, composed of a GBP 1.7m surplus on direct business and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business. The movement is attributed to favourable claims development and recoveries under the reinsurance arrangements.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development used the explicit narrative in note 10 stating a GBP 3.5m surplus run-off (composed of GBP 1.7m direct and GBP 1.8m reinsurance accepted). No separate 'movement in prior year's provision' table with an 'Insurance liabilities' column or a gross claims development triangle was provided for direct extraction; no named catastrophe events were disclosed as drivers. LOB-level reserve movements are not quantified in the statements, so LOB breakdowns are inferred or left null where not provided.
